newsitem.title: USA: Millipore to buy Tylan General.
newsitem.headline: Millipore to buy Tylan General.

text.p: Millipore Corp said it had reached a definitive agreement to buy Tylan General for about $133 million, or $16 a share in cash, plus the assumption of Tylan's outstanding debt.
Millipore, which specializes in purification technology for research and manufacturing problems in microelectronics, said it expected to close the deal in the first quarter of 1997.
The company, which planned to finance the acquisition with bank borrowings, said it expected the deal to add to its earnings by the second half of 1997.
It will "significantly enhance the long-term growth of Millipore's revenues and growth," it said in a statement.
Based in San Diego, Calif, Tylan General supplies precision mass flow controllers and other products for the microelectronics industry. Its annual sales total about $150 million.
